source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.

original_test_intent: Verify the CEM baseboard FRU (`FRU_CEMBB`) is correctly identified and its complete BMC WebUI inventory agrees with the exact read-only IPMI FRU record and approved board reference.
original_method: Resolve the CEMBB physical board, Redfish member and IPMI FRU device; collect complete protected read-only records and the WebUI view; normalize board/manufacturing/product/serial/custom fields and compare them to the authority without clearing logs or writing FRU storage.
manual_activity: The board owner supplies the CEMBB-to-management mapping, FRU layout and authoritative values. Automated collection can compare the mapped sources; an operator verifies any WebUI-only representation and the engineer adjudicates permitted encoding differences.
safety_requirements: Do not clear SEL or host logs; the source cleanup step is excluded from evidence preparation.
Run read-only FRU retrieval only; never edit FRU EEPROM, reset BMC or reboot the host.
Enumerate and map CEMBB instead of trusting a friendly URI or default `ipmitool fru print` target.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials; redact serial, asset and custom manufacturing identifiers.
Preserve raw bytes/text while normalizing padding, encoding and blank fields.
Stop on missing/duplicate board mapping or unresolved source authority rather than probing another FRU automatically.
agent_execution_scope: Validate the same CEMBB across physical map, Redfish, IPMI and WebUI.
Collect complete redacted Redfish and timestamped read-only IPMI FRU output.
Capture the WebUI CEMBB detail and normalize all approved fields.
Compare against Project reference with explicit encoding/stale/missing outcomes.
Return evidence only; do not issue DUT verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve CEMBB member/device/channel mapping and authoritative source order.
Approve FRU fields, encoding normalization and redaction.
Resolve discrepancies and issue the final verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The candidate GET is partial and insecure, assumes identity and omits the Master-required IPMI comparison; three fields cannot establish complete CEMBB correctness.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Discover the CEMBB member, read the exact IPMI FRU device and compare complete raw-to-normalized fields plus WebUI under protected access.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_CEMBB, WebUI path, ipmitool comparison, readable/correct Criterion, no Script/Bundle and 2/0-minute estimates remain unchanged.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use exact-board Redfish/IPMI/WebUI FRU parity with encoding-aware evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The selected CEM baseboard FRU implementation.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish schema and IPMI/FRU decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor CEMBB FRU layout and Project manufacturing record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds exact device discovery, complete fields, trusted access, redaction and authority rules while retaining both source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A three-field API projection is partial and does not cover IPMI or full WebUI content.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Board mapping, IPMI target, FRU layout/reference and normalization rules.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A similarly named CEM board can return plausible wrong data; cached fields and sensitive identifiers require careful handling.

project_override_considerations: A vendor FRU decoder may supplement the two source interfaces only with exact CEMBB identity, approval, field equivalence and explicit uncovered WebUI/IPMI coverage.
expected_evidence: CEMBB physical/BMC identity and exact Redfish/IPMI mapping
Complete raw redacted Redfish plus `ipmitool fru print` evidence with target metadata
WebUI capture and authoritative board reference
Raw-to-normalized per-field comparison including missing/stale/encoding differences
Preserved logs, no-write proof and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently define CEMBB FRU inventory and cross-interface correctness. The DeepSeek omission is not a Master contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The board FRU and comparison goal are clear. Mapping, layout and expected values are obtainable readiness inputs rather than irreducible blockers.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Restores the IPMI and complete-field obligations and rejects assumed insecure targeting.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on hybrid readiness and exact cross-source reconciliation after independent analysis.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Corrects acceptance of an unbound three-field resource.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Prevents adapter or CEML FRU evidence from substituting for the CEM baseboard.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: No invalid record exists for this identity.

review_improvement: Binds every CEMBB datum to one physical board and preserves raw/decoded provenance across Redfish, IPMI and UI, preventing a plausible record from the wrong CEM device from passing review.
independent_technical_reasoning: CEM platforms may expose multiple FRUs with overlapping manufacturer/product strings. Only an approved device/channel-to-board mapping plus complete encoding-aware parity can establish that the evidence is the baseboard record rather than an adapter or left-side module.
